Sonic the Hedgehog is on an adventure unlike any other! Powered by an all-new engine, Sonic Unleashed merges classic Sonic gameplay with the latest in next-generation innovation.

Merging blistering 2D action with meticulously rendered 3D environments, players race through intriguing locations across the globe as Sonic to save a chaotic world.

KEY FEATURES
  • Sonic's World Transformed: Sonic maintains his high-speed abilities during the day, but at night he is transformed into a mysterious dark form with incredible never-before-seen abilities including 3D-action brawling and amazing agility.
  • Tight Navigation and Speed Control: Using Sonic Boost, Ring Energy, Quick Step and Speed Drift, players can accelerate to super speed and avoid obstacles instantly and rocket through turns without slowing down.
  • Powerful New Engine and Cinematic Graphics: With its new propietary "Hedgehog Engine," Sonic Unleashed enhances the classic 2D perspective with mind-blowing 3D stages. Other next-gen technology capabilities include global illumination, grid computing, continuous data streaming and an intricate path finding system.
  • Enhanced and Expanded Environments: Many unique and fascinating continents await as you race to save the world in a dynamic, high-speed experience. Explore exciting unlockable areas, and dash through new and exotic locales around the world!

Many unique and fascinating continents offer the player an opportunity to save the world in a dynamic, high-speed experience during the day. In addition to exploring exciting unlockable areas, players dash through locations resembling real-life destinations including the Great Wall, Arctic Pole glaciers and many more.

Sonic's back with some all-new moves! Players can now accelerate to super speed with 'Sonic Boost' by collecting rings to increase Sonic's 'Ring Energy' level. The faster Sonic collects rings the more he can boost. Players can also avoid obstacles instantly using "Quick Step" by allowing Sonic to strafe left or right without losing speed, and take turns at high speeds by using Sonic's new 'Speed Drift'. So think on your feet and unleash your inner speedster!

Sonic Unleashed enhances the classic 2D perspective with mind-blowing 3D stages. As Sonic races across multiple continents, players will experience a seamless transition from 2-D to 3-D perspectives depending on the area of the stage. A perfect blend of Classic and New!

Powered by the all-new graphics engine; The Hedgehog Engine is built to handle the incredibly demanding requirements of a Sonic action game, allowing Sonic to race at incredible speeds through and past huge environments.

It is one of the first game graphics engines to achieve full global illumination in real-time rendering. Along with grid computing, continuous data streaming and an intricate path finding system, the new Hedgehog Engine allows Sonic Unleashed to achieve real-time graphic quality that can stand up to pre-rendered CG.

After dark, Sonic, transforms to the Werehog, and will uncover many unique and fascinating continents. While scaling walls, avoiding obstacles, fighting new enemies and uncovering hidden pathways, Sonic the Werehog will explore worldwide locations at night like never before.

Sonic maintains his high-speed abilities during the day, but at night he is transformed into a mysterious dark form with incredible never-before-seen abilities including amazing agility and 3D-action brawling! Sonic the Werehog can utilize a new Unleash mode to deal greater damage to the enemies of the night, as well as perform multiple attack moves, including the Were-Wallop Combo which sends monsters and robots flying!

In what was to be Sonic & Dr. Eggman’s final showdown, Sonic fell into Dr. Eggman’s most devious trap. Capturing the power of Sonic’s Chaos Emeralds, Dr. Eggman fires a powerful beam towards the world. With the world ripped into numerous continents, a colossal beast living in the core had been awakened. Dr. Eggman’s plan was to exploit the beast and take over the world. As a result, with increased strength, sharp claws and fangs, Sonic had been transformed into a Werehog.

What is to come of Sonic’s mysterious transformation, the fragmented planet, and the colossal beast? Has Dr. Eggman finally managed to take over the world?

Sonic is on a race against time to save the world… and himself!

Sonic is the world's fastest supersonic hedgehog, and values freedom and life by his own rules above everything else. He is kind at heart, but can be short tempered and is quick to throw himself into the middle of trouble without a second thought, remaining steadfast to the end. His personality is a juxtaposition of kindness and ferocity, as on the one hand he does all in his power to snuff out evil, but he also can't look away when somebody else is in trouble. Sonic hates boredom and being tied down, so much of his time is spent running towards the next danger or adventure.
One of Dr. Eggman's robots, this Egg Fighter is armed with a gigantic sword that has a large attack range.
Since Dr. Eggman's Egg Beetle and Egg Devil Ray were destroyed, its strengths were combined to create the Egg Lancher.
An expert aviator, Tails flies Sonic from continent to continent in his plane, the Tornado, to help him restore the fractured planet.
These aerial arsenals circle in front of Sonic, firing laser beams and missile salvos. Sometimes, they forget to keep an eye out for obstacles behind them. Whoops!
With extreme durability and a wide variety of attacks, Eggman's latest mid-sized, anti-Sonic weaponry dogs Sonic through multiple scenes.

As a side effect of Dr. Eggman's latest miscounduct, Sonic now undergoes an extreme physical transformation whenever the sun goes down, but his heart remains the same. Almost. Sonic the Werehog is still willing to put his life on the line for his friends without any due consideration, but his dedication to helping his new friend regain his memory is in no small part out of guilt that it was most likely his own fall from space that caused the problem in the first place.

As a Werehog, Sonic is not as fast as his usual self, but makes up for it in ferocious combat techniques. His powerful arms are able to stretch allowing him to attack enemies from a greater distance, and to reach distant ledges, poles and bars with ease.
The Dark Eel hides in holes in the walls and ground. Spitting out energy balls, this monster of the night will not hesitate to attack intruders, so beware!
A ferocious and evil enemy, the Titan's only mission is to destroy anything that comes across its path.
An expert aviator, Tails flies Sonic from continent to continent in his plane, the Tornado, to help him restore the fractured planet.
When the world’s people harbor especially deep wellsprings of grief and anger, they give rise to these mean monsters. They're far tougher to take out than their Nightmare cousins.

Though quick to chomp, these little guys don't pack much bite, but they make great weapons when thrown. Get enough of them together and it spells trouble.

The powered-up Red Rexes are... still not very strong. Try wielding one in each hand as dual weapons.

The world's art capital is home to a university that attracts those in search of knowledge.
This small town in the mountains has passed down it's pork bun recipe for generations.
This town of ruins and ancient customs, celebrates the Feast of the Sun and Moon.
The village is an architectural marvel, built atop the water in a jungle strewn with ancient ruins.

Exotic wild animals are a frequent site near this village built on reddish-brown soil.
